text:
maria_ops: Hey team — got a vendor update. Acme shipped 12 H100s to FRA but bucketed 6 to our EU-edge pool and 6 to dedicated pool. carrier tracking shows one pallet with minor outer-dent, vendor says units passed bench but wants RMA option.
liam_procure: Can you paste the invoice? we flagged currency mismatch earlier (EUR listed but PO in USD). that might block customs.
vendor_acme: Hi all, confirmed shipment 3Z-TRACK-887. Invoice attached in the portal; we inadvertently used EUR template for that AWB, sorry. we can reissue credit note & corrected invoice today. photos of dent sent to sophie.
noah_infra: Good to know. capacity-wise the EU-edge pool is already at 92% GPU util — if those 6 H100s are delayed we'll hit headroom problems for 8am PST jobs. can we push loaners or temporary repool?
sophie_logistics: Received dent photos — looks cosmetic, no bent fins. depot wants formal QC sign-off before returning. vendor, do you accept depot-level assessment and waive return shipping if failed?
vendor_acme: We accept depot assessment. If depot marks functional we will not accept RMA. If depot flags DOA or performance delta, we'll cover RMA shipping and replacement. we'll issue corrected invoice by EOD.
maria_ops: Liam — any chance to accelerate dedicated -> edge repool to avoid throttles? we could borrow 4 units from dedicated schedule window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
liam_procure: I can authorize temporary repool for 4, but we need CS approval. also need a signed credit memo before customs. vendor: please confirm ETA for corrected invoice and credit note (timestamped).
vendor_acme: Corrected invoice + credit memo: will send by 1769999996 (ETA ~4h). Tracking number for pallet photos: 3Z-TRACK-887.
sre_bot: @channel Alert: EU-edge pool projected to exceed SLO for p95 latency if available GPU < 10 in next 6h. Recommend repool/burst.
noah_infra: Ok executing repool plan: scheduling 4 GPUs to edge from dedicated at 1769999995 -> will update routing table. small network note: repool requires node handoff, ephemeral IP remap might add 60s connection flaps.
sophie_logistics: Depot acceptance window is 09:00-17:00 CET tomorrow. If vendor reissues invoice before customs cut, we can avoid customs hold. If not, probable hold + duties.
maria_ops: Quick checklist: 1) vendor reissue invoice & credit note by 1769999996 2) repoool 4 units scheduled at 1769999995 3) depot QC tomorrow 4) if depot flags hardware: vendor covers RMA shipping + replacement. agreed?
liam_procure: Agreed. I'll hold payment until invoice corrected. tagging @vendor_acme please follow up.
vendor_acme: Understood — sending docs now. sorry for the mix. will accept depot assessment and expedite replacements if needed. :bow:
